prompt: A children's coloring-book page, bold clean black outlines on plain white, no shading, no greyscale, no colour — pure line art ready to be coloured in. ZOOMED IN close-up view inside a friendly, wavy blood-vessel tunnel, filling the entire square frame edge-to-edge so the two wavy vessel-wall lines and every character run off all four sides of the page naturally (crop in tight, like a close-up snapshot, not a wide shot with empty space around a small scene). Show a cheerful GROUP of THREE different round white-blood-cell characters with friendly cartoon faces (simple dot eyes, a warm smile), each with an obviously different, cute hairstyle-like head shape standing in for its nucleus: one has a poofy cluster of three-to-four soft round cloud-like lobes on top like curly hair, one is a simple smooth round head, and one has a big soft folded bean shape like a jelly-bean cap. They stand or bounce together, arms and legs like a plush toy, holding hands or waving at each other. Around and among them float several small plain round red-blood-cell friends — simple circles with a gentle dimple in the middle and a tiny smiling face, no hair shape at all, clearly simpler than their white-cell friends. Add a friendly speech bubble near the white-blood-cell group with empty space for text. Big shapes, thick even outlines, generous colourable areas, everything friendly and huggable like a plush toy. Do not include any text, letters or words baked into the picture itself.
negative_notes: No decorative starburst, radiating sparkle burst, sunbeam rays or comic 'pow' shapes anywhere. No frame, box, border line, mat or white margin band around the artwork — the vessel tunnel must bleed off all four edges. No baked-in text other than the empty speech bubble outline.
speech_en: We ride the blood like a bus — and hop off wherever we're needed!
speech_de: Wir fahren mit dem Blut wie mit einem Bus - und steigen aus, wo wir gebraucht werden!
